headline: WU-TANG'S FINAL CHAMBER RETURNS
caption:
Wu-Tang Clan begins the next North American leg of Wu-Tang Forever: The Final Chamber on August 27 in Darien Center, New York. The run continues through October 4, with Bone Thugs-n-Harmony joining most dates and Atlantic City scheduled for August 28.

Source: Live Nation and Pollstar
